rca of the issue: Original bug: server.py hardcoded gateway='manual' when creating deposit, then only overwrote it AFTER a successful gateway API response. When outbound proxy IP wasn't whitelisted by PayNow/SHPAY/1SSPay/JuntBest, the row stayed as 'manual', hiding the user's actual choice. Fix at server.py:1405-1411 derives _initial_gateway from method prefix BEFORE any external call, so failures preserve the correct label. Historical rows were healed by a one-time migration (74 rows: 15 paynow, 33 shpay, 15 onesspay, 11 juntbest). Verified via GET /api/admin/deposits — zero rows with gateway='manual' AND method starting with any known gateway prefix.
